scope: Governed same-board Task movement with native confirmation, exact column/position request, board/column monotonic structure tombstones, shared task-level unresolved fence and atomic body-free ActionRun receipts
source_state: Selected uncommitted workspace snapshot. Batches 15-22 have not been committed, pushed or released. Inherited regression sources and read-only runtime dependencies included for provenance; concurrent CLI/IDE/goal/RRSI edits preserved without adopting their implementation. No session-core implementation modifications. Source bytes captured after tests and checked for stability throughout finalization.

native.adapter: Native SQLite engines through synchronous production-interface test wrappers

sqlcipher.reason: No production SQLCipher encryption or multiple-ciphers packaging acceptance performed

review.work: Implemented independent movement preview area within the existing editor's busy/pending/history state, scoped store movement and authoritative refresh; reviewed main-process dual permission checks, fixed patch, same-board reference validation, structure revisions, receipt and postcondition boundaries

input.columnId: Bounded object ID, current same-board column

governed_movement.patch_contract: Exactly columnId and position, no mixture with eight editable business fields; fixed SQL column map
governed_movement.source_response: Existing eight task fields plus movement.editable, current columnId/position and bounded same-board id/name directory
governed_movement.source_version: SHA-256 over full bounded task row, task revision, selected board metadata, board structure revision and all selected column fields
governed_movement.board_structure: One-time seeding plus six exact insert/update/delete triggers on task_boards/task_board_columns; old and new board IDs advance for ID/scope changes; no FK on revision tombstones, preventing ABA after deletion/reuse
governed_movement.trigger_profile: Nine exact production revision triggers required; all additional persistent or TEMP triggers on task, board, column, task revision, structure revision, activity and Run tables rejected
governed_movement.native_confirmation: Existing shared ApprovalGate strict/high, default cancel, actual source and destination IDs and escaped names, numeric position; queued and running persisted before dialog; current actor/generation/frame/window/database/file/context and full source checked before and after confirmation
atomic_success: Only target column_id/position and monotonic updated_at
standard succeeded ActionRun and source/approval/sqlite-board-task-move evidence
governed_movement.postconditions: Exact full task row, unchanged board/column structure and revision, activity and receipt binding validated before commit
governed_movement.movement_semantics: Same-board single-task numeric position update; ties permitted; no automatic status/completed_at synchronization or other-task reorder
governed_movement.ledger: Same task_board_update_runs and per-task running/unknown unique fence used by field edits and moves; shared hard quotas, per-connection native-operation exclusion, metadata-only history including separate unresolvedRun
governed_movement.replay: Same nonce only reads persisted outcomes, no automatic repeat mutation or dialog for running/unknown/terminal; restart loses queued in-memory capability
governed_movement.cancellation: Existing current update permission and extra board.task.action.cancel for another actor; sealing blocks late approved write without claiming to dismiss the OS dialog
governed_movement.renderer: Move preview and eight-field preview are distinct and share execution/cancel/history state; source directory raw UTF-8 budgets; store sends columnId rather than old targetColumnId alias, executes scoped request, fresh-reads task/list only after succeeded, rejects stale auth/identity/board/native invalidation and does not optimistically modify placement
governed_movement.privacy: Persistent source/approval/execution evidence and activity contain IDs, digests and metadata, not proposed body or column names; names only retained in authorized transient source/native UI
governed_movement.compatibility: Earlier board-task.update-fields and legacy board-task.update/v1 receipts remain readable and cancellable; board/column changes now invalidate new field-edit previews as well

tests_overlap: Node and better-sqlite3 groups overlap and are not summed; renderer/notification suites include inherited regression cases.
crash_recovery: Actual SIGKILL, native reopen integrity_check=ok, exact business fields/placement, task revision, activity and Run atomicity; a separate process resends the exact serialized request with zero confirmations and no replay
boundaries: Fine per-object ACL, organization multilevel approvals, other board action contracts, canonical adjuncts and other object/goal actions remain pending
Movement changes column and numeric position only, supports equal positions and retains task status/completed_at and other tasks
Legacy multirole assignment roster migration remains pending
Source bounds, missing/modified revision profile, unexpected custom triggers, nondurable adapters or exhausted quotas fail closed; no implicit repair or automatic record cleanup
One native operation per current main-process database connection; arbitrary multiprocess GUI coordination and power-loss behavior not validated
Native window/dialog/auth are injected in tests; no actual Electron GUI journey or production SQLCipher encryption acceptance
Summary HTTP protocol substitute does not prove real Ollama inference or summary quality
Cloud model policy, native whole-vault transfer, exact-commit cross-platform release matrix, publication and external business acceptance remain pending
